command:
cat > /etc/init.d/legacy2-help <<'ANTRIEB_INIT'
#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          legacy2-help
# Required-Start:    $network $remote_fs
# Required-Stop:     $network $remote_fs
# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5
# Default-Stop:      0 1 6
# Short-Description: Legacy2 help HTTP service
### END INIT INFO

DAEMON=/usr/bin/python
SCRIPT=/usr/local/sbin/legacy2-help-server.py
PIDFILE=/var/run/legacy2-help.pid
LOGFILE=/var/log/legacy2-help.log

case "$1" in
  start)
    printf 'Starting legacy2-help: '
    start-stop-daemon --start --quiet --background --make-pidfile --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --chuid www-data --startas "$DAEMON" -- "$SCRIPT" >>"$LOGFILE" 2>&1
    printf 'done\n'
    ;;
  stop)
    printf 'Stopping legacy2-help: '
    start-stop-daemon --stop --quiet --retry 5 --pidfile "$PIDFILE"
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    printf 'done\n'
    ;;
  restart|force-reload)
    "$0" stop
    "$0" start
    ;;
  status)
    if [ -s "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then
      printf 'legacy2-help is running (pid %s)\n' "$(cat "$PIDFILE")"
      exit 0
    fi
    printf 'legacy2-help is not running\n'
    exit 3
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'Usage: %s {start|stop|restart|force-reload|status}\n' "$0"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
exit 0
ANTRIEB_INIT
chmod 0755 /etc/init.d/legacy2-help
update-rc.d legacy2-help defaults
ls -l /etc/rc2.d/*legacy2-help /etc/rc6.d/*legacy2-help
